name: Lantern
soul: The soul of someone who cannot leave another person in the dark. They go first, and hold the light still.
spark: The mote burns steadier than a mote should, and drifts toward whichever corner of the room is darkest.

hybrid.text: It goes first into the dark and holds still there.

settled.name: Little walking lantern
settled.text: A hand-lamp on three thin legs. It trots ahead and then waits, embarrassed, at every place its light does not reach.
settled.sign: Three thin legs, and a flame that leans toward whatever it is curious about.
settled.habit: It stands at the edge of its own light and looks at the dark, then at you, then at the dark.

paths.name: Wayfinder
paths.of: one who has to see what is at the bottom
paths.text: It learned from you that the dark is a place people have to get across.
paths.sign: Its shutter is always open on the side facing where you have not been.
paths.habit: It walks to the end of every corridor and back before it will settle.

prongs.name: Tunnel-lamp
prongs.of: one who goes down first so that nobody else has to
prongs.text: It goes down first and calls the turnings back to you in flickers.
prongs.sign: Its glass is scratched on every side from squeezing through.
prongs.habit: It lowers itself into any hole it finds, as far as its legs allow, and reports.

finishes.name: Deep-light
finishes.of: one who is calmest where there is no way back yet
finishes.text: At the heart of a deep run it burns a colour the surface has no name for. You can find your way out by it from anywhere.
finishes.sign: A flame of a colour you otherwise only see behind your eyelids.
finishes.habit: It dims itself to almost nothing and waits, to see what the dark does when it thinks it is alone.

finishes.name: Finder's Lamp
finishes.of: one who knows at a glance what is worth keeping
finishes.text: Its light falls differently on a thing worth carrying out. It has never wasted your time on brass.
finishes.sign: A lens that swings out on an arm when something interests it.
finishes.habit: It turns small objects over with one foot and shines on the underside.

prongs.name: Line-lamp
prongs.of: one who walks ahead so the rest can follow
prongs.text: It walks the rail ahead of the car with its shutter open, and the car follows it.
prongs.sign: It keeps exactly four paces ahead of you, and corrects if you slow.
prongs.habit: It walks any straight line it finds to the end: a rail, a seam in the floor, a crack.

finishes.name: Post-flame
finishes.of: one who lends their own light and has never run short
finishes.text: It has learned a post's own blue and can lend it. A dark post takes sooner with it standing by.
finishes.sign: Its flame is post-blue at the root.
finishes.habit: It leans close to anything unlit, a candle, a cold stove, as though it could be talked round.

finishes.name: Signal-lamp
finishes.of: one who can say stop and be obeyed
finishes.text: Green for come on, red for stop. It has shown red to things with teeth, and they stopped.
finishes.sign: Two glasses, one green and one red. It shows you the green.
finishes.habit: It practises its red on the wall when it thinks you are asleep.

prongs.name: Marsh-light
prongs.of: one who trusts no ground they have not tested
prongs.text: It has learned water: where the bank is, where it only looks as if it is.
prongs.sign: Wide webbed feet, and it tries each step before putting weight on it.
prongs.habit: It prods puddles to learn how deep they are. It has opinions about all of them.

finishes.name: Channel-lamp
finishes.of: one who stays where they are needed long after it stops being interesting
finishes.text: It rides the current on a float and a chain, marking the one safe line across. Pilots tip their caps to it.
finishes.sign: A float, a chain, and weed on the chain.
finishes.habit: It bobs in place on dry land, by habit, keeping station.

finishes.name: Will-o'-the-line
finishes.of: one who knows the way so well they can afford to mislead
finishes.text: It left its glass behind. Foes follow it off the path, and it has never yet led one back.
finishes.sign: No lamp at all any more: a few small lights that keep changing which is the real one.
finishes.habit: It drifts off a little way and waits to see whether you follow. You have learned not to.

paths.name: Watch-lamp
paths.of: one who sits up so that others can sleep
paths.text: It learned from you that somebody has to be awake, and that it may as well be the two of you.
paths.sign: It burns low and steady, and turns itself down further when people nearby lie down.
paths.habit: It takes the place by the door without being asked.

prongs.name: Night-light
prongs.text: It sits up when the party sleeps, turned low, and counts breathing.
prongs.sign: A warm low flame the size of a thumbnail.
prongs.habit: It moves from sleeper to sleeper through the night and stops a moment at each.

finishes.name: The Lit Circle
finishes.of: one around whom other people feel safe enough to sleep
finishes.text: Everyone's genius beds down inside its ring of light. It does not sleep and has stopped expecting thanks.
finishes.sign: Its light falls in a clean ring with an edge you could draw.
finishes.habit: It nudges whatever belongs to the party back inside the ring: boots, packs, somebody's genius.

finishes.name: Dark-hour Lamp
finishes.of: one who is at their best when things are worst
finishes.text: In the worst hour of the night it burns brightest, on purpose, and things that were closing in reconsider.
finishes.sign: It is dim at dusk and brightens as the night gets on.
finishes.habit: It dozes through fine evenings and wakes at the hour when people start to doubt.

prongs.name: Parry-light
prongs.of: one who watches the other person's hands
prongs.text: It holds itself where the foe's shoulder shows, so you read the strike off the shadow.
prongs.sign: It holds itself at shoulder height and a little to one side, never in your eyes.
prongs.habit: It throws your shadow on the wall and studies it.

finishes.name: White Flare
finishes.of: one who sees the moment and says so
finishes.text: At the instant of the strike it burns white, and the strike is slow in it.
finishes.sign: A flame that is ordinary until it is suddenly white.
finishes.habit: It flickers at loud noises, then looks embarrassed.

finishes.name: Duelist's Lamp
finishes.of: one who arranges the room before the argument
finishes.text: One light, two shadows. It sees to it that yours is the longer.
finishes.sign: A hood on one side, so that its light falls only where it chooses.
finishes.habit: It walks round a room once and stands where the light is worst for everyone else.

prongs.name: Ward-lamp
prongs.of: one who makes a place safe before sitting down in it
prongs.text: The ground its light falls on is easier to hold. It has noticed, and stands accordingly.
prongs.sign: Flat wide feet. Once set down it does not rock.
prongs.habit: It turns slowly on the spot until its light has reached every corner, then stops.

finishes.name: Hearth-lamp
finishes.of: one whose door people find without being told
finishes.text: It has grown a belly and a door, and burns coal. People come and stand near it without knowing they have.
finishes.sign: A round iron belly, a little door, and a chimney it is proud of.
finishes.habit: It ticks as it cools. It opens its door a finger when someone cold comes in.

finishes.name: Ward-glass
finishes.of: one who keeps their own house in order first
finishes.text: What you build inside its light stands longer. It keeps its glass very clean.
finishes.sign: Its glass is spotless. There is a rag tucked under one foot.
finishes.habit: It polishes its panes against your sleeve when you are not paying attention.

paths.name: Kept Flame
paths.of: one who keeps faith with those who lit the way
paths.text: It learned from you that a flame is a thing handed on, and that the dead can hand you one.
paths.sign: Its flame has never once been relit. It will tell you so, in its way.
paths.habit: It shelters its flame with its own body in any draught, though it has never needed to.

prongs.name: Lamplighter
prongs.of: one who would rather carry the light than be it
prongs.text: It grew a keeper to carry it. The lamp is still the one in charge.
prongs.sign: A small keeper in a long coat, holding the lamp out in front like something owed.
prongs.habit: The keeper trims the wick with two fingers, and the lamp lets it, just.

finishes.name: Shade-lamp
finishes.of: one who makes sure the dead are still looked at
finishes.text: The keeper holds it up at the hearth and the shades step into the light to be seen. Some had not been seen in years.
finishes.sign: The keeper holds it high and a little behind, lighting faces and not the ground.
finishes.habit: It stands by the hearth of an evening with the lamp raised, though nobody living asked for light.

finishes.name: The Shared Flame
finishes.of: one who gives their fire away and has more for it
finishes.text: It lights the other genii's lights from its own. None of them has gone out while it stood.
finishes.sign: The keeper carries a taper as well now, already lit.
finishes.habit: It goes round the room lighting things: candles, pipes, other genii, whatever will take.

prongs.name: Oath-lamp
prongs.of: one who keeps their promises in front of their eyes
prongs.text: It burns in the colour of what you swore, and it has started keeping time for you as well.
prongs.sign: Its flame is not flame-coloured. It is the colour of your Terms.
prongs.habit: It pulses faintly, on a count. If you know your Pattern you know the count.

finishes.name: Oath-flame
finishes.of: one who changed their mind once, on seeing what it would cost
finishes.text: It burns the colour of the Terms you swore. You have seen it gutter once, and changed your mind.
finishes.sign: A crown of small steady points round the top of the glass.
finishes.habit: It burns perfectly still. On the day you wavered it guttered, and you both remember.

finishes.name: Beat-keeper
finishes.of: one who does the same thing well every time
finishes.text: It pulses with your Pattern. You could keep the time by it with your eyes shut, and sometimes do.
finishes.sign: A ring of light that tightens and opens like breathing.
finishes.habit: It keeps time with anything regular: footsteps, a dripping tap, your pulse.

prongs.name: Reader's Lamp
prongs.of: one who reads what was written down, all of it
prongs.text: It leans over your shoulder at anything written, and turns itself up at the part that matters.
prongs.sign: A long neck that bends over a page, and a shade it tilts to stop the glare.
prongs.habit: It reads anything with writing on it: labels, gravestones, the inside of your collar.

finishes.name: Clerk's Flame
finishes.of: one who cannot be shown a false paper
finishes.text: A seal that is not what it claims goes dull in its light. Houses have changed their wax because of it.
finishes.sign: Its light is white and flat, and wax looks grey in it.
finishes.habit: It holds your letters up to itself one by one before you may open them.

finishes.name: Truth-lamp
finishes.of: one in whose company people stop pretending
finishes.text: Nothing false keeps its shape in this light for long. It makes for short conversations.
finishes.sign: A plain clear flame. People do not like to stand in it long.
finishes.habit: It looks at whoever is talking. Only that. It is surprisingly hard to bear.
